label: FortiSwitch 124F-FPOE 24-port switch, 24 PoE+ ports, 370 W
description: Fortinet FortiSwitch 124F-FPOE 1 RU Layer 2 PoE+ switch: 24x GE RJ45 all 802.3af/at PSE (370 W budget), 4x 1/10G SFP+ uplinks, 128 Gbps switching capacity, 190 Mpps.

poe.note: 24 PoE ports, 370 W total. 370 W is 24 x 15.4 W (369.6 W): every port can run a Class 3 (802.3af) device, twelve can run a Class 4 (802.3at, 30 W) device, and 24 x 30 W = 720 W is not available. Internal AC supply, 449.8 W average / 451.3 W maximum consumption fully loaded.

fabric.note: Datasheet switching capacity 128 Gbps duplex with 190 Mpps: 24x 1G plus 4x 10G is 64 Gbit/s of line rate, doubled to 128 Gbps full duplex.

notes: Datasheet: 24x GE RJ45 and 4x 10GE SFP+; 24 (802.3af/at) PoE ports, 370 W budget; 128 Gbps switching capacity, 190 Mpps, 32 K MAC, <1 us latency, 4 K VLANs, 2 MB packet buffer, 512 MB DDR3, 64 MB flash, ACL 640, 32 spanning-tree instances. 44 x 260 x 330 mm, 3.82 kg, side-to-back airflow, smart fan. Every copper port is a PSE port; the four SFP+ cages are not. FortiLink ports 21-28; SFP+ cages 25-28 (124F QuickStart Guide). Console RJ-45 at 115200 8-N-1 by default (https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortiswitch/7.6.5/enterprise-data-center-switching-with-evpn-vxlan-deployment-guide/313313/deployment-procedures), console IP 192.168.1.99. Layer 2 only - routing is the FortiGate's over FortiLink. Same 370 W as the 148F-POE spread over half as many ports, so this is the box that can feed 24 PoE+ devices at once.
